toolsPreview.name: generate_color_scheme
toolsPreview.description: Generates a Material Design color scheme from one or more key colors. Always use this when you need to create a color scheme for an application. The input is one or more named colors in hex format, and the output is a color scheme with a map of color role names to colors in hex format.

toolsPreview.name: search_icons
toolsPreview.description: Finds appropriate Material Design icons matching keywords that describe their usage, style, or shape.
